g.text: M08 CMI confirms AI solution | end 2027
M13 Verified AI assisted solution | end 2026
Last eligible saved quote at each cutoff. A quote can be old. Participants can include bots.
M01 to M04 share the saved AI-alone wording. Each row is a different deadline question.
The other rows use different rules. M11 and M12 are clones of M01 and M05.
No quote means no eligible observation was recovered at that cutoff. It does not mean 0%.
Historical rule edits are not fully recoverable. Exact trade dates and rule notes are in the saved data.
Source: Manifold public API, retrieved 30 Sep 2026. Market observations add no survey wave.
